modal_login.title: Remote Browser Session Renewal
modal_login.local_description: In development, sign in opens Chrome on the computer running the Python microservice.
modal_login.local_instruction: Keep this panel open and complete sign in in the local Chrome window. The Nodia browser only checks status through Nodia Server.
modal_login.unavailable: Remote sign in is not enabled yet. The browser cannot call the private microservice directly.
modal_login.operator_instruction: An operator must renew the session from the server's private environment. Renewal from Nodia will become available after a secure administrative flow is implemented.
modal_login.status_pending: Waiting for sign in in Chrome...
modal_login.error_title: Could not sign in to Gemini
modal_login.error_desc: Sign in did not complete. Check the Chrome window and try again.

modal_sync_models.no_models_selected_error: You must select at least one model to proceed.
modal_sync_models.no_main_model_error: You must choose a primary default model among the selected models.

detail.default_provider_desc: Sets this provider as the primary choice for inference and analysis operations.
detail.default_mode_desc: Sets this connection mode as the default for this provider.
detail.no_active_modes_desc: Enable a Web or Agentic mode to manage the models and session of this connection.
detail.agentic_desc_active: The service confirmed an available adapter and an active agentic session. Capabilities depend on the discovered model.
detail.agentic_desc_inactive: The Antigravity integration or session is unavailable. Having the app installed does not confirm an operational connection.
detail.quota_subtitle: Real-time monitoring of compute windows and request limits.
detail.quota_5h_desc: Rolling 5-hour compute window for inferences and deep reasoning.
detail.quota_weekly_desc: Weekly cumulative compute window of the Google One account.
detail.quota_web_desc: Only recently observed Web metrics are shown. These are not tokens or requests.
detail.sync_requires_operational: To sync models, the web session must be operational. Please sign in to the remote browser first.
detail.sync_disabled_unauthenticated: The web plan token is not authenticated or the session expired. You must authenticate in the remote browser first before synchronizing models.
detail.sync_disabled_no_api_key: No API keys configured for this provider. Add at least one API key before updating models.
detail.sync_disabled_no_active_api_key: No active API keys for this provider. Activate at least one API key before updating models.
detail.sync_disabled_generic: The provider is not operational to synchronize models. Please verify the connection status.
detail.model_deprecated_warning: The previously active model is no longer available. {{model}} has been automatically selected.
detail.extended_thinking_desc: Enables deep reasoning deliberation steps before generating output. Only applies to models with detected reasoning capability.
detail.extended_thinking_not_supported: The service does not report reasoning capability for this model.
detail.reasoning_level_desc: Reasoning effort level (thinking) sent for this model: Low, Medium or High.
detail.ocr_focus_desc: Marks this model as the preferred choice for OCR tasks. Note: Actual inference will run on the currently selected active model.
detail.empty_models_desc: This provider does not have any models loaded yet. Click 'Update models' to query and synchronize available models directly from the provider API.
detail.models_subtitle: Configuration and routing of generative model architectures according to workload, operational cost, and multimodal context.
detail.temperature_desc: Lower randomness for deterministic and consistent responses.
detail.safety_desc: Block medium/high risk content. Corporate regulatory compliance.
detail.exclusive_mode_subtitle: Mode switching is strictly manual. An operational failure will never change the default mode.
detail.mode_web_desc: Simulates interactive headless browsing for enterprise accounts with unified SSO. Recommended for scraping agents, extended reasoning and non-API quotas.
detail.mode_api_desc: Direct connection via standard REST API tokens. Ideal for structured payloads and low international latency.
detail.mode_web_disabled: Not enabled for this provider (requires dedicated microservice).
detail.web_session_desc: This status reflects authentication reported by the service.
detail.cloud_bridge_desc: Open the remote browser enabled by the service to authenticate the Google session.
detail.cloud_bridge_security: Complete authentication on the Google page in the remote browser.
detail.remote_browser_caption: Opens the remote connection provided by the service.
detail.profile_name_helper: Isolated storage namespace for session cookies.
detail.remote_region_helper: Location of the headless Chromium pool hosting the session.
detail.inactivity_timeout_helper: Time after which the worker shuts down the browser instance.
detail.auto_reconnect_desc: Exponential backoff retry intervals before suspending queued tasks.
detail.notify_email: Notify via email if session expires
detail.notify_email_desc: Dispatch alerts to administrators assigned to the AI management role.
detail.api_keys_subtitle: API key pool with autonomous failover and automatic rotation upon quota exhaustion (429).
